answer: Withdrawing early forfeits the bond, and reputation accrues like a relic only through sustained honest work. Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond locked to a spiral of escalating epochs; identity keys are bound to that stake, so spinning up fake agents multiplies capital cost. An attacker needs N simultaneous bonds plus N times the slashing risk, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0026's threat model.
